description: This file defines the AnyPopupKeyboard class, a subclass of AnyKeyboard, responsible for creating and managing popup keyboard layouts in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It includes methods for constructing popup keyboards with variable rows, adding popup keys, handling skin tones and genders for emoji keys, and mirroring keys horizontally.

classes.name: AnyPopupKeyboard
classes.description: A class representing a popup keyboard in the AnySoftKeyboard project, capable of dynamically creating popup key layouts, supporting emoji skin tones and genders, and mirroring keys.

methods.name: AnyPopupKeyboard
methods.description: Constructor for creating a popup keyboard with a specified XML layout resource.

methods.name: AnyPopupKeyboard
methods.description: Constructor for creating a popup keyboard with specified characters, dynamically generating keys.

methods.name: getPopupLayout
methods.description: Determines the XML layout resource based on the number of popup rows.

methods.name: isAlphabetKeyboard
methods.description: Indicates that this keyboard is not an alphabet keyboard.

methods.name: getPopupRowsCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of rows needed for the popup based on character count.

methods.name: findKeyWithSkinToneAndGender
methods.description: Finds a key matching specified skin tone and gender attributes.

methods.name: findKeyWithPredicate
methods.description: Finds a key in the list that matches a given predicate.

methods.name: addPopupKeysToList
methods.description: Adds popup keys to the key list based on characters and layout parameters.

methods.name: getSentenceSeparators
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no sentence separators.

methods.name: getMinWidth
methods.description: Calculates the minimum width of the keyboard, including additional width for popup keys.

methods.name: getDefaultDictionaryLocale
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no default locale.

methods.name: getKeyboardName
methods.description: Returns the name of the keyboard.

methods.name: getKeyboardId
methods.description: Returns a fixed identifier for the keyboard.

methods.name: addGenericRows
methods.description: Overrides to prevent adding generic rows in popup keyboards.

methods.name: keyboardSupportShift
methods.description: Indicates that shift support is delegated to the parent keyboard.

methods.name: createKeyFromXml
methods.description: Creates a key from XML, with additional handling for emoji and skin tone keys.

methods.name: mirrorKeys
methods.description: Mirrors the position of keys horizontally for visual effect.
